title: Where Is It? Position Vectors Explained Simply | PUC Physics Class 11
description:
A pin on a map, a seat number in an exam hall, a treasure map: all three answer one question. Where exactly is it? Aarav parks his bicycle somewhere on the college ground and points "over there". Physics answers how far and which way with a single arrow. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Physics (NCERT Chapter 3, Motion in a Plane) we build the position vector and the displacement vector.

You will watch a live ride from P to Q with the position arrow swinging and stretching, a graph of x and y against time, and a slow-mo replay. We derive delta r = r2 - r1 step by step from a vector triangle, move the origin to show that position changes but displacement does not, and compare position and displacement side by side with two pause-and-think questions. Then a worked example in i, j form, the exam trap of subtracting the wrong way, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, JEE Main and NEET students.

In this video:
0:00 A map pin, an exam seat, a treasure map
0:29 The position vector: one arrow, two answers
1:04 Live ride from P to Q, slow-mo replay
1:47 Derivation: delta r = r2 - r1, step by step
2:27 Move the origin + pause and think
3:08 Position vs displacement, side by side
3:44 Worked example: A (1, 2) to B (6, 14)
4:21 Exam trap: subtracting the wrong way
4:43 Practice question (JEE Main pattern)
5:26 Recap and three questions to answer

Next episode: Vector Components in Two Dimensions. One slanted arrow hides two straight arrows inside it.
